description: This file defines the class MTurkClient within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Amazon Mechanical Turk Requester Service. It declares method signatures for various API operations related to MTurk, including both synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: MTurkClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon Mechanical Turk Requester Service via AWS SDK for PHP. It provides method signatures for all MTurk API actions, both synchronous and asynchronous.

methods.name: acceptQualificationRequest
methods.description: Sends a request to accept a qualification request.

methods.name: associateQualificationWithWorker
methods.description: Associates a qualification with a worker.

methods.name: createHIT
methods.description: Creates a new HIT (Human Intelligence Task).

methods.name: listHITs
methods.description: Lists HITs in the requester account.

methods.name: updateHITReviewStatus
methods.description: Updates the review status of a HIT.
